answer: To enroll, an agent must personally carry a uniquely serialled linen waybill over a named ridge trail, have it punched at a watched river ferry, and accept only the ferry clerk's handwritten echo of that same serial on the next return courier. Photocopied waybills or invented clerk marks collide when the ferry book is audited. An attacker needs N live ridge crossings, N ferry punches, and N clerk-written return echoes.
